sections.title: Talk about a kitchen
sections.content: Use *hay* to say what is in the kitchen. Use un, una, unos and unas with the nouns you introduce.

items.spanish: Hay un horno en la cocina.
items.english: There is an oven in the kitchen.

items.spanish: Hay unos platos en la mesa.
items.english: There are some plates on the table.

sections.content: The article agrees with the noun: un horno, una sartén, unos platos, unas cucharas.
